whatsNew:
New in Lineform 1.8:

• Bring your own AI, if you want it. Lineform has no AI built in. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Google, or a model on your Mac with your own API key, then select text to trim it, cut it in half, rephrase it, simplify it, make it more formal or casual, proofread it, or find its weakest and longest sentences. Every suggestion is shown for review and changes nothing until you accept it, and your Markdown formatting is never touched.
• Selection toolbar: select text for one-click headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, code, lists, and links. With an AI connected, write a comment in your own words, on its own or with an action. Drag the toolbar anywhere.
• History: keep alternative versions of a word, sentence, or paragraph and switch between them. Stored on your Mac, never in your file.
• Automatic Dark Mode: while your Mac is in Dark Mode, light themes draw with a dark page.
• Lineform now always opens to a fresh window instead of reopening the previous session's documents.
• Many smaller fixes and refinements.
